raw_sections.experience:
EXPERIENCE
Technical Product Consultant | Adobe Inc.





04/2025-Present (Noida) Delivered technical support/consulting for Adobe Workfront, ensuring seamless platform functionality and optimal user experience across global clients. Troubleshot and resolved complex issues related to workflows, API integrations, system performance, and user permissions, reducing ticket resolution time. Configured and optimized Workfront Fusion automations, approval processes, and reporting dashboards to improve project visibility and operational efficiency. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to escalate and document critical issues, contributing to faster product enhancements and bug resolutions. Authored and maintained detailed case notes, solution documentation, and knowledge base articles to drive knowledge sharing and reduce repeat incidents.
Technical Support Engineer
Shreemate Financial Services
• • • •
|
08/2024-04/2025 (Noida)
Provide technical support for enterprise customers using Adobe Workfront. Troubleshoot issues related to reports, custom forms, workflows, approvals, and user permissions. Investigated system behavior using logs, API responses, and backend analysis to identify root causes. Assist customers with report building, calculated fields, filters, and dashboard configurations. Collaborated with Engineering and Product teams to escalate and resolve complex platform issues.
Workfront Analyst
Capgemini
•
|
10/2022-08/2024 (Gurugram)

• •
Managed end-to-end Workfront configuration including custom forms, queues, routing rules, and layout templates. Created and optimized reports and dashboards for PMO, executives, and functional teams to improve visibility and decision-making. Troubleshot complex issues related to permissions, sharing, Proof approvals, Resource Planner calculations, custom field logic, and user setup. Built form-based project request queues with automated routing and approvals. Participated in troubleshooting calls and provided clear technical explanations to internal teams.
